user_story: As a user, I want to navigate between the iframe example links on the Frames page so that I can access related content. Acceptance criteria: 1. The user should be able to click the link 'Nested Frames' and be redirected to the URL '/nested_frames'. 2. The user should be able to click the link 'iFrame' and be redirected to the URL '/iframe'. 3. The footer element with ID 'page-footer' should be visible after navigation.
